## Integrated TOPO / NINO computer release candidate

**Exact review commit: `1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e`** · Draft; no merge/deploy/owner-server change.

Same PR61, no competing implementation. The exact approved refined SVG is integrated through one shared selector/multi-way/Discover importer; Rome's circle encloses Vatican and both leader tips match the source. Existing other overlapping-location compositions use consistent pointer ink. All45 objects, all11 chapters, both maps, Discover→Point→Write, Nino/onboarding, Gold, pizzas/Vespa and saves remain intact.

**Role correction:** Hermes owns integration and the lead verification below. **Codex owns fresh independent technical QA**, per the current owner mission. Older author reports requesting independent Hermes acceptance are historical and superseded. No independent verdict is claimed here.

### Standalone download
[TOPO-NINO-Computer-Release.html](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/releases/download/topo-nino-computer-approved-artwork-rc-20261030/TOPO-NINO-Computer-Release.html) — **3,152,649 bytes**.

SHA-256: `422f39dd06cb2ea2d6524ce07e4524738aa425aef5c5e54d63b55d90b54143a9`.

Actual anonymous browser download, byte equality and reopening through file:// with networking disabled PASS. No server required. Runtime/asset/released bytes remain identical to implementation commit `b3540f72b2e21ede842bd38051e6a7015eaa0aa6`; this finalization adds lead evidence and reproducible QA only. Existing prerelease and older downloads were not replaced. Export/import JSON before moving file paths or browsers.

### Executed lead validation
- Lint, production build, **17 test programs**, release/preservation audits PASS. Typecheck is a documented no-op.
- **All45 in both styles PASS separately in installed Chrome156 and WebKit27.2**: per engine 180 correct pointer trials, 90 wrong trials, 180 writing trials; wrong-Gold rejection, reload and duplicate-credit protection.
- **280 chooser cases + 280 layouts**, **12 Point/Test/Gold sessions**, exact owner SVG **8 mode/order cases**, seven responsive viewports and semantic/route/reward regressions PASS.
- **679/799 finite overlap cells PASS, 1,358 same-XY mouse taps**. **120 unaddressable integer-pixel border samples excluded, not passes**; not continuous-space coverage.
- Actual JSON export/transfer to fresh storage, invalid/cancelled imports preserving memory/storage, reload, schema1/2 imports and stage/Gold daily-credit replay without duplicate pizza rewards PASS.
- Captured offline startup/console errors and external requests: none.

### Evidence and Codex handoff
[Current delivery + reproduction](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/INTEGRATED_RELEASE_CANDIDATE.md) · [Codex independent acceptance checklist](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/CODEX_INTEGRATION_QA_HANDOFF.md) · [Machine summary](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/summary.json) · [Chrome 45-row ledger](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/integrity/ledger.json) · [WebKit ledger](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/webkit/ledger.json) · [Downloaded-byte proof](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/download/verification.json).

Visuals: [approved reference](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/fidelity/owner-original.png), [Rome/Vatican](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/fidelity/point-original.png), [swapped numbers](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/fidelity/point-swapped.png), [Naples/Vesuvius](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/selection/revised-desktop-school-naples.png), [Catania/Etna](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/selection/revised-desktop-school-etna.png), [all other selector captures](https://github.com/dennisariens/topo/blob/1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e/docs/qa/integration-lead-20261030/selection).

### Remaining gates / scope limits
**Native Safari NOT TESTED:** actual safaridriver session blocked by disabled Allow Remote Automation; no setting changed. WebKit27.2 PASS is not native Safari acceptance. Physical iPad/OS keyboard/IME/VoiceOver NOT TESTED. All45 uses per-item question fixtures, not a full natural-route all45 playthrough; DOM suite separately covers all11 chapters. Geography matches pinned source/projection baselines; eight schematic extents are not freshly GIS-certified. See report for finite coverage exclusions.

Codex must review this exact full SHA/artifact independently and return PASS/CONDITIONAL/FAIL with evidence. Owner approval remains required. No new artwork, passport, reward feature, merge, final release or deployment.

References: #59, #60, #58, #38, #51, #25.

Owner approved the Pisa box **art direction**, not a verified animatable rig. This PR records a reproducible 3-flavor / 11-stop frame projection candidate and source-hash checks, plus an explicit visual REWORK verdict. Real frames inspected in the design conversation still show wrong-way print orientation, early pizza exposure and missing lid-underside/occlusion, so they are NOT promoted or included in Git. Original masters and static open-box reward fallback are untouched; #31 remains open. This is a bounded candidate and QA handoff, not a completed hinge or app release. See `assets/nino/rewards/pizza/hinge/README.md`. No deploy/merge requested.

## Owner-approved artwork handoff — 30 October 2026

The approved TOPO/NINO micro-icons are committed as **actual binary files** under `assets/nino/app-icon/micro-v2/` (not just mockup images): 16px Italy-only, 24/32/48/64px red scooter + Italy, `favicon.ico` containing the 16 and 32 PNGs, editable SVG masters, checksum manifest and use instructions. Git commit `5cfcbc37eb6b0266d76d2c05404d993908611410`.

All six binary Git blob SHAs were independently matched to the exact files exported in the art conversation, and the GitHub tree contains all ten planned assets with correct sizes. 16px contains **no scooter and no Nino face** by owner request. The large illustrated Nino/Vespa icon remains the separately approved large-size design; this PR deliberately does not replace it or change its actual app usage.

**Art-only scope:** no `index.html`, PWA manifest, application build, release branch, map, learning/reward state, or existing owner assets were modified. No iPad/desktop installation claims. Hermes is already integrating; when ready, Hermes/Codex can cherry-pick the single art commit or consume these assets, integrate favicon and inline data URI fallback for true offline standalone `file://`, and independently verify tiny-size clarity and icon caching. No need to interrupt current Hermes integration run.

This is a draft **art handoff** PR, not permission to merge or deploy.

**31 Oct 2026 — Owner visually approved the original Venezia postcard with the authentic transparent scalloped edge.** Original painting is unchanged; Rialto Bridge feels a little oversized to the owner but is explicitly a later optional redesign, not a release blocker. This scoped art branch commits the 572-point approved-stamp contour and a tested Pillow-based exporter to generate full and tight transparent 1536×1024 PNG + lossless WebP from the existing repository master. It keeps original RGB pixels unchanged; rebuilt SVG-derived edge alpha is a close approximation (a measured 0.1264% of pixels deviate by >64 alpha from owner-reviewed raster matte), so not byte-identical to the original reviewed export. Exact owner-reviewed large PNG/WebP binaries were generated locally but **not pushed** due to connector binary transfer limit; do not claim them as Git files. See `assets/nino/travel-passport/postcards/exports/README.md`. Local generation and lossless WebP vs PNG pixel equality were executed. No app/integration/award logic changed; Hermes integration remains separate, no merge/deploy requested.

Issue #67 bounded artwork closeout, stacked on PR #61 at `1bf86b3e1c69319bed8ef877243070a64d97a12e`.

**Exact delivery SHA: `2a9dda3d3d8ec567687bc3b61bf9cbde645c752c`**

Adds actual PR66 Venezia full/tight PNG/WebP binaries, both distinct Gold seal native/small exports, corrected ISOLE, ARRIVO, ten accepted stamp copies, normalized folio copies and approved postcard/reverse exports. Original masters remain preserved. The 239-row measured inventory distinguishes source blobs, actual delivery files, approval conditions and real runtime usage. Existing static Pisa fallback files are retained; hinge remains OPTIONAL DEFERRED under #31 / PR63.

Only runtime change: exact approved PR65 ICO/16px/32px inline favicon links. Every other app HTML byte equals PR61. No passport implementation, chapter/postcard unlocking, learning/geometry/save/reward changes, parallel app or published-download replacement.

**Executed:** build, lint, full17-program test chain, release audit and map preservation audit pass. Actual Chrome156 `file://` offline checks pass at1500x1000 and800x900: no external requests/page/console errors, embedded and exported image decoding, all11 chapter source icons, original poses, 8 correct→1pizza /24→3pizzas→1trip and save reload. Native-size captures, exact outputs and114 checksums are committed. Historical audit adapters allow only exact pinned favicon bytes; no teaching/reward assertions removed. Intermediate failures and fixes are documented.

Candidate HTML:3,156,792bytes; SHA256 `3203f1b4cd9b72b60ed5301fdeafc9fd59988d1b12fb75ce22902b130b50b635`.

**GO FOR INDEPENDENT QA of this bounded export delivery; not package DONE or final acceptance.** Hermes must review this exact SHA. Passport/chapter/postcard runtime integration remains pending. Folios are1086x1448 with owner exception pending. Venezia uses the authorized572-point reconstruction: visible PNG/WebP RGBA and alpha match; transparent RGB codec exceptions are recorded. Exact owner-reviewed original matte/ZIP was not provided at a Git path, so exact-reference comparison remains blocked. Native Safari/OS favicon cache/physical-device/owner acceptance untested. No merge/deploy/release authorization.
